# aegis-runtime
> Ultra-high-performance sovereign agent runtime in native Rust with local model inference on Grace Blackwell GB10. Replaces legacy Node.js/TypeScript runtimes with sub-millisecond execution, zero cloud token bills, and proactive autonomous heartbeats.

## Overview
- Repository: https://github.com/aien-dev/aegis-runtime
- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later, with the nonbinding COVENANT.md.
- Language: Rust 2021
- Runtime: Pure native compiled binaries. Zero Node.js. Zero Python daemons.

## Architecture
- Axum Gateway: Sub-millisecond WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), and REST API on port 18096.
- Heartbeat Engine: Proactive autonomous background tick loop (60s period). Executes digital colleague workflows without requiring human prompts.
- Inference Engine: Direct HTTP client to the local model seat, any OpenAI-compatible server on port 18006 (atlas-lightning-omni on GB10), with SSE streaming.
- Persistence: Embedded SQLite with Write-Ahead-Logging (WAL) mode for sub-millisecond ACID history and state storage.
- Vector Math: Plain Rust cosine similarity, token entropy, projection, and temperature scaling (src/vector_math.rs).
- Security: Hardware TPM key vault (atlas-vault). Zero disk secrets. Dynamic memory resolution and automatic secret redaction ([REDACTED_BY_ATLAS_VAULT]).

## Quickstart
```bash
cargo build --release
./target/release/aegis serve --port 18096
```

## Endpoints
- `GET /health` & `GET /api/v1/health`: Engine health, model ID, uptime, and heartbeat counters.
- `POST /v1/chat/completions`: OpenAI-compatible completions with multi-turn chat and SSE token streaming.
- `GET /v1/models`: OpenAI-compatible models listing.
- `GET /api/v1/skills`: List registered skills.
- `POST /api/v1/skills/execute`: Execute a registered skill.
- `POST /api/v1/chat`: Direct inference request to the local model seat.
- `POST /api/v1/heartbeat/tick`: Force an immediate heartbeat tick.
- `POST /api/v1/tasks` & `GET /api/v1/tasks`: Task queue creation and listing.
- `POST /api/v1/shell`: Local shell execution.
- `GET /events` & `GET /api/v1/events`: SSE event stream for autonomous heartbeats.
- `GET /ws` & `GET /api/v1/ws`: Full duplex WebSocket with real-time heartbeat pulse pushes.
